dial.summary: BTC recovered above $60K from last week's flush as funding rates remain near-zero (0.0025%), confirming the deleveraged market structure; Global M2 holds at $103.9T with an expanding 4-week trend and ISM Manufacturing at 55.5% (10th consecutive expansion) underpin the macro bid — DXY headwind at 103.84 and real yields at 2.90% are risks to watch, but the fully deleveraged futures market and stable $6.74T Fed balance sheet continue to argue for accumulation ahead of the December 1 ISM print and December 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103,884B ($103.9T) as of November 20, 2026; 3-month change +1.55% per StreetStats; MacroMicro Sep 2026 G4 snapshot was $104.3T; October G4 aggregate not yet published; 4-week trend UP (3-month basket growing); status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction signal).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2), above consensus 54.7%, up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); next release December 1, 2026 (November data).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 103.84 on November 20, 2026 per CNBC (prior close 103.895; 52-week high 103.97 set November 19); 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 20 to 103.84, net +2.1 points (+2.1%), well above the 0.5% flat threshold; hawkish Fed tone and strong ISM driving DXY; status headwind (above 100 threshold — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield at ~2.90% as of November 20–21, 2026; Treasury 10-year TIPS reopening auction on November 19 cleared at 2.903% (highest since 2002); tracker shows 2.92% on Nov 16; 4-week change Oct 20 (~2.85–2.90%) to Nov 20 (~2.90%) = ~0–5bps, within flat threshold; status neutral (above 2% but flat trend — headwind requires both rising trend AND above 2%).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread at +30bps as of November 19–21, 2026 (recessionpulse.com Nov 19: 0.30; Nov 10: +25bps; Nov 6: +35bps); 4-week comparison: Nov 5 was +38bps, now +30bps = flattened ~8bps over 4 weeks, exceeds the 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN (flattening); curve is steepening off the inversion low but losing some recent momentum; status neutral (positive spread, not inverted — headwind requires < -50bps).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M); 4-week change Oct 22 (~$6.755T) → Nov 18 ($6.741T) = -$14B = -0.2%, within flat threshold; next H.4.1 release November 27; status supportive (QT effectively ended, balance sheet stable YoY).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at ~0.0025% per 8h as of November 21–22, 2026 (Coinglass BTC page: 0.0025%; futures page shows brief dip to -0.0020% during sell-off; Binance funding briefly negative Nov 22; CryptoNews: 0.0032%); 30-day trend FLAT — oscillating near zero or slightly negative throughout October–November after the deleveraging flush; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold; BTC recovering above $60K on no sustained negative funding confirms organic demand).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap $281.5B (DefiLlama Nov 20, down from $283.1B Nov 19 as supply contracts from May 2026 peak of $311.4B); total crypto ~$2.0T estimated (BTC $1.18T market cap per CoinDesk Nov 20 at $58,683 / ~59% dominance); derived stablecoin dominance ~14.1%, up from 12.8% on Nov 19 as BTC dropped ~9.6% in 24h; 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 21 to ~14.1%; BTC.D ~59%; status neutral (dominance rising but TOTAL market falling — headwind requires rising stables AND rising TOTAL simultaneously).

upcoming.title: S&P Global Flash PMIs (November 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases flash estimates for US Manufacturing and Services PMIs for November 2026 at 9:45 AM ET; first real-time read on November business activity ahead of the December 1 ISM Manufacturing PMI; a Services print above 55 would reinforce the sticky-inflation narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC decision; Euro area flash PMIs also released same morning.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases November 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET (last Tuesday of month); tracks current conditions and 6-month expectations; a deterioration from October's level would signal cracks in the consumer spending backdrop ahead of the November 25 PCE release.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 — Second Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP second estimate at 8:30 AM ET on the compressed Wednesday pre-Thanksgiving schedule (Nov 26 Thanksgiving); watch consumer spending and PCE deflator revisions for any upside that would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case; released same day as October PCE on thin pre-holiday liquidity.

upcoming.title: PCE Inflation / Personal Income (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays at 8:30 AM ET; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — a hot core reading above +0.3% MoM would seal the December 9 FOMC hike after October CPI surprised at +0.4% MoM; this is the last major inflation print before the November 29 FOMC blackout period starts.
